description: This file is a test harness for sessions spawn functionality in an OpenClaw agent system, utilizing vitest for mocking and testing various components such as gateway calls, configuration, and subagent interactions.

methods.name: getCallGatewayMock
methods.description: Returns the mock function for gateway calls.

methods.name: getGatewayRequests
methods.description: Retrieves all gateway requests made during tests.

methods.name: getGatewayMethods
methods.description: Extracts the method names from the gateway requests.

methods.name: findGatewayRequest
methods.description: Finds a specific gateway request by method name.

methods.name: resetSessionsSpawnConfigOverride
methods.description: Resets the session spawn configuration to default.

methods.name: setSessionsSpawnConfigOverride
methods.description: Overrides the session spawn configuration with a new one.

methods.name: resetSessionsSpawnAnnounceFlowOverride
methods.description: Resets the subagent announce flow override to default.

methods.name: resetSessionsSpawnHookRunnerOverride
methods.description: Resets the hook runner override to null.

methods.name: setSessionsSpawnHookRunnerOverride
methods.description: Sets a new hook runner override.

methods.name: setSessionsSpawnAnnounceFlowOverride
methods.description: Overrides the subagent announce flow with a custom function.

methods.name: getSessionsSpawnTool
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the sessions spawn tool with dependencies set for testing.

methods.name: setupSessionsSpawnGatewayMock
methods.description: Sets up a mock implementation for the gateway, tracking calls and simulating responses.
